column1: # Kirby Air Riders (Switch 2, update v458752, display version 1.3.3). Plays on the Mac: see README.md
# The engine's namespace is phx, its platform layer Aurora (WindApplication), SDK 20.5.26 built for the Switch 2 (Ounce), NVN2. PhysX 5.2, an own sound engine (Sygnus), NPLN for online play.
# Modules main, subsdk0 (CUDA, which main imports 49 functions from), sdk; subsdk1 (NGX, DLSS through Vulkan) is not imported by main.

# Packed from a NUP with scripts/pack_nup.py: a base package and an update package, each a whole RomFS. Shaders: 27,540 NVN2 programs in PMAP records of Asset/assets_a000.dat (shader_split.py pdat_shaders), 28 in Bin/Nvn2-upper_left.ndsr.

# The Switch 2's 9 GB. The NPDM declares 32 MB of system resource, so virtual address memory is on. Measured through a race: the alias region mapped up to +13.78 GB of its 16 GB, 5.0 GB at most at once
# The game fills textures from the CPU in place while it plays, with no NVN call over the texels: without both keys some props and panels stay all-zero ASTC, which Metal decodes as magenta
